heading_path: 20A.14  Representation before Panel of Disciplinary Tribunal
text: (1) At a hearing before a Panel of the Disciplinary Tribunal, the incorporated trade marks attorney must be represented by a trade marks attorney director of the incorporated trade marks attorney or a legal practitioner. (2) A party to proceedings before the Panel, or a representative of the party, may request the Panel Chair to summon witnesses.
